# Cathy

> > A lifestyle blog celebrating holidays, recipes, and cultural traditions with a focus on Filipino cuisine, American celebrations, and family-friendly activities.

Cathy offers seasonal recipes, holiday decoration ideas, and cultural content spanning Filipino traditions (chopsuey, chicken inasal), American holidays (4th of July, Thanksgiving, Christmas), and international celebrations (Diwali, Ramadan). The site features practical guides for home cooks, party planners, and families looking to celebrate special occasions.

## Key Topics

- Filipino cuisine
- Christmas traditions and recipes
- Holiday decorations and DIY crafts
- 4th of July celebrations
- Thanksgiving recipes and activities
- Bridal and wedding content
- Cultural festivals (Diwali, Ramadan)
- Family-friendly activities
- Seasonal desserts
- Party planning
- Philippine Christmas customs
- American patriotic holidays
- Holiday entertaining
- Mason jar desserts
- Kids' activities

## Christmas Celebrations

- [Christmas in the Philippines](https://cathy.snydle.com/christmas-in-the-philippines.html): Filipino Christmas traditions: Simbang Gabi, Misa de Gallo, Noche Buena
- [21 Christmas Desserts in A Jar To Try](https://cathy.snydle.com/21-christmas-desserts-jar-try.html): Mason jar dessert recipes for holiday baking and gift-giving
- [30 Christmas Breakfast Ideas](https://cathy.snydle.com/30-christmas-breakfast-ideas.html): Festive Christmas morning breakfast recipes for families and kids
- [Beautiful Christmas Centerpiece Ideas](https://cathy.snydle.com/christmas-centerpiece-ideas.html): DIY Christmas table centerpieces and holiday entertaining decorations
- [DIY Door Decoration For Christmas](https://cathy.snydle.com/diy-door-decoration-for-christmas.html): Santa, Grinch & snowman DIY door decorations for Christmas
- [20 Christmas Crafts Ideas](https://cathy.snydle.com/christmas-crafts.html): DIY Christmas ornaments, wreaths & budget-friendly holiday crafts

## Filipino Recipes

- [Chopsuey Recipe](https://cathy.snydle.com/chopsuey-recipe.html): Filipino chopsuey recipe with chicken and vegetables
- [Chicken Inasal Recipe](https://cathy.snydle.com/chicken-inasal-recipe.html): Bacolod City grilled chicken inasal recipe from Negros Occidental

## American Holiday Celebrations

- [4th of July Recipes](https://cathy.snydle.com/4th-of-july-recipes.html): Patriotic red, white & blue recipes for Independence Day celebrations
- [4th of July Quotes](https://cathy.snydle.com/4th-of-july-quotes.html): Independence Day quotes on Declaration of Independence & American freedom
- [Thanksgiving Turkey – Tips For Buying Turkey For Thanksgiving](https://cathy.snydle.com/thanksgiving-turkey.html): USDA-based guide for selecting and buying Thanksgiving turkey
- [Thanksgiving Party Games](https://cathy.snydle.com/thanksgiving-games.html): Family-friendly Thanksgiving party games and entertainment ideas
- [Halloween Activities for Kids](https://cathy.snydle.com/halloween-activities-for-kids.html): Kid-friendly Halloween activities, costume parties & trick-or-treating

## Wedding and Bridal

- [Beautiful Bridal Mehndi Designs](https://cathy.snydle.com/bridal-mehndi-designs.html): Indian, Pakistani & Middle Eastern bridal henna art designs
- [Wedding Quotes, Messages and Wedding Wishes](https://cathy.snydle.com/wedding-quotes.html): Marriage quotes from Barbara de Angelis, Martin Luther & others
- [Bridal Shower Favors Ideas](https://cathy.snydle.com/bridal-shower-favors.html): DIY bridal shower favor ideas and personalized guest gifts

## International Cultural Celebrations

- [Diwali Festival](https://cathy.snydle.com/diwali-festival.html): Hindu Festival of Lights traditions in India and Nepal
- [What Is Ramadan](https://cathy.snydle.com/what-is-ramadan.html): Islamic fasting month, Quran revelation, and Eid-al-Fitr practices

## Optional

- [Smores Recipes – Quick and Easy Desserts](https://cathy.snydle.com/smores-recipes-quick-and-easy-desserts.html): S'mores dessert recipes with Hershey's chocolate and campfire treats
